div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Government crop statistics + UPAg / DES
State, district, crop-start year, season
Harvested area hectares and production tonnes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GADM 4.1 district boundaries
Exact normalized same-state district join
Representative longitude and latitude
Boundary representative points, not farm GPS

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
NASA POWER daily weather
Preserved CSV + cached recent JSON responses
Join exact location and calendar dates
No generated daily observations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Observed target YIELD
Production tonnes / harvested hectares
Target never enters predictor inputs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Measured rice master
2,642 rows x 30 columns
68 matched districts in AP, KA, TN, TG
Crop-start years 2001-2024

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Audit exact daily joins
Recompute full-season means and totals
Reconcile all 2,642 master records
Abort on missing weather or mismatches

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Season calendar proxies
Kharif: Jun-Nov, crop-start year
Rabi: Nov-Apr, crosses calendar year
Autumn: Sep-Dec, crop-start year
Winter: Dec-Mar, crosses calendar year
Summer: Mar-Jun, following calendar year

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Forecast input prefix
Stop 60 days before proxy season end
No later weather supplied to neural network
Proxy season end is not observed harvest date

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Consecutive ten-day bins
Temperature/atmospheric channels: means
Rain, land evaporation, radiation: totals
Keep partial last bin and its day count
7-13 valid timesteps per observation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
11 values at EVERY timestep t
0 Tmax C; 1 Tmin C; 2 Tavg C
3 vapour pressure hPa; 4 wind m/s
5 precipitation mm; 6 land evaporation mm
7 solar radiation kWh/m2 per bin
8 relative humidity percent; 9 pressure kPa
10 number of days in bin
EVLAND is land evaporation, not FAO ET0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Chronological partitions, unchanged rows
Train: 2001-2020, 1,984 observations
Validation: 2021-2022, 321 observations
Test: 2023-2024, 337 observations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fit scaling on TRAINING ONLY
Weather mean/std across valid training bins
Longitude/latitude mean/std from training rows
Target mean/std from training labels
Exclude padding from fitted statistics

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Scale and pad
Weather x[t,c] = (value - train mean[c]) / train std[c]
Pad tail with zeros to 13 steps
Retain true lengths [B]
Weather tensor [B,13,11]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Static vector [B,11]
2 scaled coordinates
4 state one-hot flags
5 season one-hot flags
No observed yield, production, crop-year trend,
district embedding, end-season crop area or price

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Six CPU runs
LSTM, masked 1D CNN, CNN-LSTM
Seeds 42 and 73 for each architecture

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AdamW optimizer
Learning rate 0.001; weight decay 0.01
MSE on standardized target
Batch 64; gradient-norm clipping 5
Maximum 150 epochs; early-stop patience 25

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Validation RMSE selects checkpoint and model
LSTM best: 0.563130 t/ha
1D CNN best: 0.559138 t/ha
CNN-LSTM best: 0.542541 t/ha
Select CNN-LSTM seed 42, epoch 9

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Evaluate frozen winner once on 337 test rows
MAE 0.474861 t/ha
RMSE 0.599986 t/ha
R-squared 0.191802
Modest performance, not an accuracy percentage

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Export selected weights to ONNX
Parity verified on train, validation and test
Maximum yield difference below 0.000001 t/ha
Intermediate activations exposed for inspection
No retraining or test-driven model reselection

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
User inputs
Map-selected district; season
Average seasonal temperature, 10-40 C
Rice area and total land size
Optional rainfall, humidity, wind, radiation
Date is automatic; no year/month selector

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Validate finite values and ranges
Rice-planted area cannot exceed total land
Resolve selected district/season reference
Unsupported location/season returns an error

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Training-only weather trajectory
Median values per bin for local district-season
No target yield enters reference construction
No current-weather download

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Missing local weather reference
Blend nearest training district-season templates
Prefer same state, otherwise same-season donors
Up to 3 donors; inverse-distance weights
Keep target district's own coordinates/state
Display donor names, distances and weights

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Apply user assumptions to reference window
Shift Tmax/Tmin/Tavg by average-temperature change
Rain prefix total = seasonal rain x prefix-days / season-days
Allocate rain over reference bin pattern
Humidity: reference shift, clipped to 0-100
Wind: entered value per bin
Radiation: entered daily value x bin days
Recompute vapour pressure from temperature/humidity

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Scenario tensors
11 channels at each valid timestep
Same saved train-only scaler and padding policy
Weather [1,13,11], lengths [1], static [1,11]
Reference assumptions, not measured current sequences

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Weather input [B,13,11]
True lengths [B]; B=1 for app prediction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transpose weather axes
[B,13,11] to [B,11,13]
Apply valid-length mask before convolution

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Convolution layer 1
Conv1d 11 to 32 channels
Kernel 3, stride 1, padding 1
Output [B,32,13]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GELU activation then padding mask
Learn 32 local temporal feature channels
Output [B,32,13]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Convolution layer 2
Conv1d 32 to 32 channels
Kernel 3, stride 1, padding 1
Output [B,32,13]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GELU then padding mask
Two layers give a five-bin receptive field
Transpose to [B,13,32]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Time t=1
Input: 32 convolution features x1
Initial h0 and c0 are zero

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Time t=2 ... valid T
Inputs: xt [B,32], previous ht-1 [B,32], ct-1 [B,32]
Shared learned LSTM gate weights across time

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
LSTM gates at each valid t
i = sigmoid(Wi xt + Ui ht-1 + bi)
f = sigmoid(Wf xt + Uf ht-1 + bf)
g = tanh(Wg xt + Ug ht-1 + bg)
c = f * ct-1 + i * g
o = sigmoid(Wo xt + Uo ht-1 + bo)
h = o * tanh(c)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Select final VALID hidden state [B,32]
Training uses packed lengths
ONNX gathers last valid unidirectional output
Padding does not become the selected state

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Static branch input [B,11]
Scaled longitude/latitude
Selected state and season one-hot values
Supplied once per observation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Concatenate along feature axis
32 final hidden values + 11 static values
Joined dense input [B,43]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Linear regression hidden layer
43 to 64 values, [B,64]
GELU activation
Dropout 0.2 during training only

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Final Linear 64 to 1
Standardized yield z [B]
Continuous regression, no softmax

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Inverse target transform
Yield t/ha = z x training-target std
+ training-target mean
Nonfinite / negative output returns an error

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Rice-planted area in hectares
Total land is validation only
Neither area nor price enters t/ha network

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Production tonnes = predicted t/ha x hectares
Mass kilograms = tonnes x 1,000

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Optional selling price INR/kg

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Gross value INR = kg x entered price
Before costs; not a profit estimate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reference-occlusion sensitivity
Replace one weather channel with its train-bin mean
Or replace coordinate/state/season group with train reference
Re-run network: effect = original yield - reference yield
13 effects; not additive, causal, fixed weights or percentages

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Click stage in Architecture
Actual raw/scaled timestep values
Conv1 and Conv2 outputs [T,32]
LSTM states at every valid t [T,32]
43 joined inputs; 64 dense activations; z
Heatmaps show activations, not feature importance

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Optional typeset PDF
Selected inputs, yield, production, calculations
Sensitivities and limitations
Combined export can include uploaded crop photo

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Scope of claims
Measured test sequences differ from current template scenarios
Missing-district accuracy is unmeasured
No soil/fertilizer/irrigation effect learned without observations
Image health does not reduce or alter predicted yield
